# 1. Library
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)   
library(emmeans)  
library(multcompView) 

dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05 
drop_stunted_head    <- TRUE  
# drop plots flagged student/straw
include_castle_dome  <- FALSE  # Fig. 1 caption says Castle Dome is omitted
# Castle Dome is ommitted 
use_manuscript_names <- TRUE  
# data sheets: Astroid / Ekpo / Valleso
# manuscript:   Asteroid / Expo / Vallejo

maturity_levels <- c("very early", "early", "medium", "late", "very late")
maturity_labels <- c("Very early\n(<50 DAT)", "Early\n(50-55 DAT)",
                     "Medium\n(56-60 DAT)", "Late\n(61-65 DAT)",
                     "Very late\n(>65 DAT)")

```

# 2. Helper Functions
```{r}
# Tukey letters from the standard emmeans/multcomp cld(). "a" = lowest mean.
# Called as multcomp::cld so loading multcomp doesn't mask dplyr::select
tukey_letters <- function(emm, alpha = 0.05) {
  cl  <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(emm, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey",
                                     alpha = alpha))
  grp <- setNames(trimws(cl$.group), as.character(cl[[1]]))
  unname(grp[as.character(as.data.frame(emm)[[1]])])
}

# runs of 3+ are collapsed. Keeps labels short so they fit ex. abcde = a-e
compress_letters <- function(s, min_run = 3) {
  vapply(s, function(x) {
    idx  <- sort(match(strsplit(x, "")[[1]], letters))
    runs <- split(idx, cumsum(c(1, diff(idx) != 1)))
    paste(vapply(runs, function(r) {
      if (length(r) >= min_run) paste0(letters[min(r)], "-", letters[max(r)])
      else paste(letters[r], collapse = "")
    }, ""), collapse = ",")
  }, "", USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Fit  response ~ variety + (1 | rep), return model, anova and a tidy table
analyse_one <- function(dat, response) {
  dat <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[response]])) %>%
    mutate(variety = droplevels(factor(variety)))
  fit <- lmer(as.formula(paste(response, "~ variety + (1 | rep)")), data = dat)
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ variety)
  tab <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(letters_full = tukey_letters(emm, alpha),
           letters      = compress_letters(letters_full),
           n            = as.vector(table(dat$variety)[as.character(variety)]))
  list(fit = fit, anova = anova(fit), emm = emm, table = tab, data = dat)
}
```

# 3. Data
```{r}
d <- read.csv("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Personal/R/Alternaria variety/data/variety 2021-2022 no BC 1611.csv", strip.white = TRUE,
              fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") # BOM otherwise breaks 'Year'
d$variety <- trimws(d$variety)

if (use_manuscript_names) {
  fix <- c("Astroid" = "Asteroid", "Ekpo" = "Expo", "Valleso" = "Vallejo")
  d$variety <- ifelse(d$variety %in% names(fix), fix[d$variety], d$variety)
}

# Maturity group = 2022 heading class, one value per cultivar
mat_map <- c(ex_early = "very early", early = "early", medium = "medium",
             late = "late", ex_late = "very late")
maturity <- d %>% filter(Year == 2022) %>%
  count(variety, heading) %>% group_by(variety) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  transmute(variety, maturity = factor(mat_map[heading], levels = maturity_levels))

```

# 4. AUDPC

## 4.1 Leaf AUDPC 2022 from raw ratings
```{r}
leaf_days_2022 <- c(0, 5, 11, 16, 21)

audpc <- function(y, t) {       
  if (any(is.na(y))) return(NA)   
  sum(diff(t) * (head(y, -1) + tail(y, -1)) / 2)
}

raw_leaf22 <- read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Personal/R/Alternaria variety/data/Variety raw data-2022.xlsx", skip = 3,
                         col_names = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))[, c(1, 6:10)]
names(raw_leaf22) <- c("plot", "l1", "l2", "l3", "l4", "l5")
raw_leaf22$audpc_new <- apply(raw_leaf22[, 2:6], 1, function(r)
  audpc(as.numeric(r), leaf_days_2022))

span <- diff(range(leaf_days_2022))          # 21 days
d <- d %>%
  left_join(raw_leaf22[, c("plot", "audpc_new")], by = "plot") %>%
  mutate(
    # only replace plots the CSV kept (its NAs = stunted / missing plots stay NA)
    audpcl     = ifelse(Year == 2022 & !is.na(audpcl), audpc_new, audpcl),
    raudpcl    = ifelse(Year == 2022 & !is.na(raudpcl), audpcl / (span * 100), raudpcl),
    raudpcl100 = ifelse(Year == 2022 & !is.na(raudpcl100), raudpcl * 100, raudpcl100)
  ) %>%
  select(-audpc_new)

d <- d %>% mutate(rep = factor(rep), Year = factor(Year))
```

## 4.2 Leaf AUDPC --> each year separatly 
```{r}
leaf <- lapply(c("2021", "2022"), function(y)
  analyse_one(d %>% filter(Year == y), "audpcl"))
names(leaf) <- c("2021", "2022")

```

## 4.3 Year by cultivar interaction 
Uses relative AUDPC. The two years have different rating windows (69 vs 23) so raw AUDPC isnt comparable between years, but rAUDPC is
```{r}
dd <- d %>% filter(variety != "Castle Dome", !is.na(raudpcl100)) %>%
  mutate(variety = droplevels(factor(variety)))
fit_int <- lmer(raudpcl100 ~ variety * Year + (1 | Year:rep), data = dd)
aov_int <- anova(fit_int)
```

# 5. Figure 1
```{r}
fig1_dat <- bind_rows(lapply(names(leaf), function(y)
  leaf[[y]]$table %>% mutate(Year = y))) %>%
  left_join(maturity, by = "variety") %>%
  mutate(upper = emmean + SE)

if (!include_castle_dome) fig1_dat <- filter(fig1_dat, variety != "Castle Dome")

# Order cultivars inside each maturity group by 2022 mean (high -> low)
ord <- fig1_dat %>% filter(Year == "2022") %>%
  arrange(maturity, desc(emmean)) %>% pull(variety)
fig1_dat <- fig1_dat %>%
  mutate(variety  = factor(variety, levels = ord),
         maturity = factor(maturity, levels = maturity_levels,
                           labels = maturity_labels))

ymax1 <- max(fig1_dat$upper) * 1.20

fig1 <- ggplot(fig1_dat, aes(variety, emmean, fill = Year)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.78) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Letters are rotated 90 deg and sit just above each error bar. Stops them from running into neighbors
  geom_text(aes(y = upper + ymax1 * 0.012, label = letters),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.6) +
  facet_grid(~ maturity, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2021" = "#785EF0" , "2022" = "#FFB000", alpha = 0.7 )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ymax1), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 600, 200)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Leaf AUDPC", fill = "Year") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    # angle = 90 + hjust = 1 reads bottom-to-top and ends at the axis
    # (angle = -90 / 270 is what made the names read 'backwards')
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.12, "in"),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.justification = "right",
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.12, "in"),
    legend.margin    = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  ggsave(file.path("output", paste0(name, ".png")),  p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 600)
  ggsave(file.path("output", paste0(name, ".tiff")), p, width = w, height = h,
         dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
}
save_fig(fig1, "Figure1_leaf_AUDPC", 7, 4.2)
```

# 6. Head severity
July 24th 2022
```{r}
raw22 <- read_excel("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Personal/R/Alternaria variety/data/Variety raw data-2022.xlsx", skip = 3,
                    col_names = FALSE, na = c("", "NA"))
names(raw22)[1:23] <- c("plot", "row", "rep", "trt", "variety","leaf_0708", "leaf_0713", "leaf_0719", "leaf_0724", "leaf_0729","audpc_leaf5", "audpc_leaf4",
  "head_0713", "head_0719", "head_0724", "head_0729", "audpc_head4", "audpc_head3", "maturity_class", "days_after_planting", "days_after_transplant", "stunted", "remark")

head22 <- raw22 %>%
  mutate(variety = trimws(variety), rep = factor(rep)) %>%
  filter(variety != "BC 1611")                       # removed from the CSV too
if (use_manuscript_names) {
  head22$variety <- ifelse(head22$variety %in% names(fix),
                           fix[head22$variety], head22$variety)
}
head22 <- head22 %>% left_join(maturity, by = "variety")

# Cultivars with no usable head data on July 24:
#   no head symptoms ever ............ Burgundy, Montebello
#   symptoms only on the last rating . Vallejo, Diplomat, Imperial (July 29)
#   no heads formed (very late) ...... Expo, Avenger, Iron man, Marathon
head_excluded <- c("Burgundy", "Montebello", "Vallejo", "Diplomat", "Imperial")
head_dat <- head22 %>%
  filter(!variety %in% head_excluded, maturity != "very late") %>%
  { if (drop_stunted_head) filter(., is.na(stunted) | stunted != "yes") else . } %>%
  mutate(severity = head_0724, variety = factor(variety))

head_res <- analyse_one(head_dat, "severity")
```

## 6.1 Senstivity checks (only if want to report)
```{r}
# (a) keep the stunted plots
head_all <- analyse_one(head22 %>% filter(!variety %in% head_excluded,
                          maturity != "very late") %>%
                          mutate(severity = head_0724, variety = factor(variety)),
                        "severity")

# (b) sqrt transform (severity is a bounded %, with many zeros)
head_sqrt <- analyse_one(head_dat %>% mutate(severity = sqrt(severity)), "severity")
```

```{r}
# Residual diagnostics for the primary model
png("output/head_model_diagnostics.png", 1600, 800, res = 200)
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(fitted(head_res$fit), resid(head_res$fit), xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residual",
     main = "Residuals vs fitted"); abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
qqnorm(resid(head_res$fit)); qqline(resid(head_res$fit))
par(op); dev.off()

```

```{r}
fig2_dat <- head_res$table %>%
  left_join(maturity, by = "variety") %>%

fig2_dat <- fig2_dat %>%
  mutate(variety  = factor(variety, levels = fig2_dat$variety),

                           labels = maturity_labels[1:4]))

ymax2 <- max(fig2_dat$upper) * 1.12

fig2 <- ggplot(fig2_dat, aes(variety, emmean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#f56103", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.35) +

            vjust = 0, size = 3) +
  facet_grid(~ maturity, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-5, ymax2), expand = c(0, 0),

  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8.5),

        panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.12, "in"))

save_fig(fig2, "Figure2_head_severity_July24", 5.5, 3.8)
```

# 8. Table
```{r}
tab_leaf <- bind_rows(lapply(names(leaf), function(y)
  leaf[[y]]$table %>% mutate(Year = y))) %>%
  transmute(Year, variety, n, mean = round(emmean, 1), SE = round(SE, 1),
            letters, letters_full)
write.csv(tab_leaf, "output/leaf_AUDPC_means_letters.csv", row.names = FALSE)

tab_head <- head_res$table %>% left_join(maturity, by = "variety") %>%
  transmute(variety, maturity, n, mean = round(emmean, 1), SE = round(SE, 1),
            letters, letters_full) %>% arrange(desc(mean))
write.csv(tab_head, "output/head_severity_July24_means_letters.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# One wide table
table1 <- maturity %>%
  left_join(tab_leaf %>% filter(Year == "2021") %>%
              transmute(variety, leaf2021 = mean, l2021 = letters), by = "variety") %>%
  left_join(tab_leaf %>% filter(Year == "2022") %>%
              transmute(variety, leaf2022 = mean, l2022 = letters), by = "variety") %>%
  left_join(tab_head %>% transmute(variety, head0724 = mean, h0724 = letters),
            by = "variety") %>%
  arrange(maturity, desc(leaf2022))
write.csv(table1, "output/Table1_draft.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```
